55 years at a company…
and you get a certificate.

In this video, we’re looking at “employee appreciation” posts and what they actually look like in practice — plaques, donuts, forced LinkedIn videos, and the classic “company family” narrative.

Because when you step back for a second…
it’s kind of hard to call this appreciation.

We go through a few examples and add some context to what’s really being celebrated (and what isn’t).
